Nirapod brand

Your family, our priority. A map pin that holds a family: two adults and a child, in emerald with a subtle emerald to teal gradient. Calm, trustworthy, vector only (SVG and Android vector drawables).

Android launcher icon (adaptive, vector)

Foreground: white pin, 56dp tall, inside the 66dp safe zone of the 108dp canvas. Background: emerald to teal gradient. Monochrome layer for Android 13 themed icons.

Splash (native, then Flutter)

Native splash (Android 12+ SplashScreen API and pre-12 launch theme): the 128dp app tile centred on the app background, light #F6F8F7 / dark #0B1512. The Flutter SplashBrand starts on exactly that frame, then lifts the tile and reveals the wordmark and tagline with a soft pulse ring.

Illustrations

"Who are you?" cards and the Welcome background. Faceless flat figures, brand palette, few colours.
